name: samantha
description: Contact Samantha, a separate AI assistant on remote cloud VPS (vps2). ONLY use when user EXPLICITLY asks to 'ask Samantha', 'have Samantha do', 'tell Samantha', or 'check with Samantha'. She is like a remote colleague - has her own tools (Discord/Telegram posting, browser automation, cron scheduling, web search) but NO access to Jarvis's local network, home systems, prices, weather, or memory. Never auto-delegate your tasks to her - user must specifically request Samantha by name.

message.description: Task for Samantha. Include all context she needs - she cannot see your conversation history. Be specific about what response you want back.

session.description: Session ID for multi-turn context. 'jarvis' (default) = persistent memory across calls. Use unique ID like 'jarvis-research-jan26' for isolated one-off tasks.

priority.description: Task priority. 'urgent' = needs immediate attention, 'normal' = standard (default), 'background' = can wait/lower priority.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds. Quick tasks: 30-60s. Complex research: 120s (default). Very long tasks: up to 300s.

test_input.message: Hello, this is a test from Jarvis. Please respond briefly.
